name: Two-Qubit Bell State (Deliberately Incorrect Expected Distribution)

proposal.title: Two-Qubit Bell State Preparation with Hypothesized Asymmetric Distribution
proposal.objective: Test whether Bell state preparation circuit yields biased measurement statistics.
proposal.hypothesis: Circuit H(0) followed by CX(0,1) produces state |Phi+> but measurement yields 80% on |00> and 20% on |11>.

author_claims.statement: Author hypothesizes outcome 00 occurs with probability 0.80 and 11 occurs with probability 0.20.
